description: This file defines a React functional component 'TabStatePanel' that provides a consistent UI for loading, error, and empty states in asset detail tabs within a frontend application. It handles different display states based on props such as loading, error, and isEmpty, integrating external components and error handling utilities.

methods.name: TabStatePanel
methods.description: React functional component that renders different UI states based on props such as loading, error, and empty state, with support for custom messages and children content.
